Scripts.OnClick: local checked = self:GetChecked() if checked then PlaySound(856) -- SOUNDKIT.IG_MAINMENU_OPTION_CHECKBOX_ON else PlaySound(857) end -- SOUNDKIT.IG_MAINMENU_OPTION_CHECKBOX_OFF self.OnClick(self, checked)
Scripts.OnEnter: self.isMouseover = true if self.tooltipText and self.tooltipText ~= "" then C_Timer.After(0.25, function() if self.isMouseover then if GameTooltip then GameTooltip:ClearLines() GameTooltip:SetOwner(self, "ANCHOR_RIGHT", 10, -9.5) GameTooltip:AddLine(self.tooltipText, 1, 1, 1) GameTooltip:Show() end end end) end
Scripts.OnLeave: self.isMouseover = false if GameTooltip and self.tooltipText and self.tooltipText ~= "" then GameTooltip:Hide() end

Scripts.OnLoad:
self.label = self:GetText() self.selectioned = false self.activated = true self.modified = false self.SetState = function()
if not self.label then self.label = self:GetText() or "" end if self.selectioned then if not self.activated then self:SetText("|cFF7070FF> "..self.label.." <") else self:SetText("|cFF14FF14> "..self.label.." <") end elseif not self.activated then self:SetText("|cFF4545FF"..self.label) elseif self.modified then self:SetText("|cFFFF0000"..self.label) else self:SetText(self.label) end
end self.Click = function() local parent = self:GetParent() local childs = {parent:GetChildren()} for _,child in next, childs do child.selectioned = child == self child:SetState() end self:OnClick() end
Scripts.OnClick: if self.selectioned then if not self.OnActivate then return end self.activated = not self.activated self:SetState() self:OnActivate() else self:Click() end
Scripts.OnLeave: self.isMouseover = false local tooltip = self.tooltipText if(tooltip and tooltip ~= "") then GameTooltip:Hide() end
